title: Arrays are values
hints: Every history entry ends up identical. Something is shared when it should have been copied.
A slice is a reference to a backing array, so appending `board` stores the same reference again and again. An array ([3]int) is a value: assigning or appending it copies all of its elements.
Declare `var board [3]int` and `var history [][3]int`, then append(history, board) on each move. The conversion loop at the end is no longer needed.
